quote.text: Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.
quote.author: Simone Weil, letter to the poet Joë Bousquet, 13 April 1942

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Steel Patek 1436
stories.headline: Phillips offers a steel Patek Philippe 1436 in Geneva today
stories.dek: The estimate is two to four million Swiss francs, for one of only two known in this configuration: 33 millimetres, made in 1945, sold in New York on 11 May 1949.

stories.headline: Akira Yoshizawa’s 1954 notation turned origami from a children’s craft into a discipline
stories.dek: The subreddit has about 126,000 members, up 13.8 per cent in a year; Japan’s technical convention caps at 400; a Korean festival drew 30,000 in six days.

stories.headline: Shops in Japan no longer sell tax-free; the refund now happens at the airport
stories.dek: In force across Japan since 1 November: pay the full price at the till, carry the goods unchecked to a customs terminal, and complete it within 90 days of purchase.

stories.headline: Herzog names a prime minister on Sunday after 67 members back Gadi Eisenkot
stories.dek: Netanyahu got 46. But 19 of the 67 are Arab-led members both men refuse to govern with, which leaves Eisenkot on 48 of 120 — thirteen short.

stories.headline: Police arrest Karen Chen at Changi over Prince Group; S$700m now restrained
stories.dek: Chen Xiuling, 44, was charged on Friday over a false agreement filed with JTC Corporation in September 2022 — a paperwork charge carrying ten years.

stories.headline: The X rating on a Stetson has no standard, and Hatco says so itself
stories.dek: Stetson’s own store prices a 1000X at $5,600 and a 10X at $600 and states beaver content for neither. Lock sells a Superfino Montecristi at £1,895.

stories.headline: Qualcomm’s handset revenue fell 26 per cent; Amazon warrants cover $60bn of purchases
stories.dek: Chips for phones brought in $5.14bn against $6.96bn a year earlier, and Qualcomm is raising prices across the range, blaming wafer, packaging and memory costs.

stories.headline: Nothing’s Headphone (1) Pro reaches Singapore at S$549, as a pre-order
stories.dek: SoundGuys measured 87.4 per cent total attenuation but placed the sound quality in the bottom quarter of the over-ears it has tested. TechRadar gave the Pro three stars out of five.

stories.headline: Godzilla Minus Zero takes ¥910m on its Japanese opening day, a live-action record
stories.dek: Kogyo Tsushinsha counted 590,000 admissions on Tuesday 3 November, which was Culture Day. Singapore saw the film on 5 November, a day before the United States.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Screen Rules At Thirteen
stories.headline: Strict screen rules buy 56 minutes a day in Oregon’s 8,089-child analysis
stories.dek: The Oregon team found the advantage decays by about 13 minutes for every year the child ages, interval 7.9 to 18.2. Mean age across the waves analysed: 13.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The AI De-Rating
stories.headline: Nasdaq fell 5.5 per cent on Thursday as Nvidia shed $440bn of market value
stories.dek: Brent fell 16.8 per cent in five sessions to $97.93, and the Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4 per cent in the same week, 8 votes to 1.

stories.headline: A 27-trial review in Biological Research for Nursing finds cuff training raises blood pressure
stories.dek: In adults over 60 the mean difference against no exercise was 5.30 mmHg systolic, interval 0.48 to 10.12. A BMC Geriatrics umbrella review is blunter still.

stories.kicker: The Diary · The Formula One Deadline
stories.headline: Singapore Grand Prix tickets go on general sale at 10am on Wednesday 11 November
stories.dek: Raffles Grandstand at S$1,268, the Paddock Club and the Sky Suite have already sold out. In Tokyo, four major exhibitions admit a twelve-year-old free.

stories.headline: From 1 March Japan surcharges 1,042 medicines, and one ministerial order widens the list
stories.dek: Seventy-seven ingredients, from hay-fever tablets to purified water, honey and white petrolatum. The whole measure raises ¥90bn for Tokyo — 0.18 per cent of national medical spending.
